summary: Avalon GloboCare Corp. filed an 8-K announcing its subsidiary Avalon Quantum AI LLC's collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to support Phase 2 development of the Catch-Up agentic AI video platform, with Caylent, Inc. appointed to lead development. AWS has agreed to provide $125,000 in contingent funding, subject to project completion within 7 months (estimated 4 months). The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This filing is a routine business update regarding a technology partnership and contingent funding, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change.
